name: @amodalai/example-underwriting-review
description: An Amodal example that triages commercial insurance submissions against an underwriting guide: two triggered tools, a reviewer subagent, five stores, plus and a custom React UI with a screen for the underwriter and a screen for the broker, whose Analyze button fires the same triage through the chat surface and whose Decide and Submit actions fire tools no agent can call.

amodal.name: underwriting-review-example
amodal.description: Triage commercial property submissions against a fictional underwriting guide. The underwriting-reviewer subagent scores each submission and recommends a workflow status for a human underwriter. The agent assists; a human decides.
